EventItemActionText:
Roll Call:
Ms. Couchman, Mr. O’Keefe, and Ms. Hanley were present.
Ms. Shelley and Mr. Penati were absent.
Staff present:
Deputy Director, Kelly O’Brien and Board Clerk, Patricia Taylor

Request approval of tenant panels for the business located at 374 Maple Ave E., Docket No. PF-1973466-BAR, in the AE, Avenue East, zoning district; filed by Lisa Matthews, Project Contact.
Applicant present: Patty Papworth (representing applicant).
The applicant proposed a replacement tenant panel on an existing pylon sign. Board members discussed consistency of color with existing tenant panels and noted fading of existing signage. No public comments were received.
Motion: Ms. Couchman moved to approve the request as submitted.
Second: Mr. O’Keefe
Motion Carried (3-0)
EventItemTitle: 374 Maple Ave E - Matthews Law Sign

EventItemActionText:
Request approval of an updated sign for the church located at 541 Marshall Rd SW., Docket No. PF-2044292-BAR, in the RS-16, Single-Family Residential, zoning district; filed by Luuwen Day, Project Contact.
Applicant present: Afaywa from Chinese Christian Church and Luuwen Day.
The applicant proposed modifying the existing monument sign by adding a new panel. Board members expressed concern regarding the proposed materials, attachment method, and overall appearance relative to the existing masonry sign. Discussion focused on improving integration with the existing structure, including color adjustments, mounting methods, panel layout, and potential elevation changes. Board stated that Staff will provide written guidance to the applicant and coordinate with the sign manufacturer prior for resubmittal. No public comments were received.
Motion: Mr. O’Keefe moved to defer the request with recommendations discussed during the hearing, including considerations related to color, mounting method, height, and panel layout.
Second: Ms. Couchman. 
Motion Carried (3-0)
EventItemTitle: 541 Marshall Rd SW - Chinese Christian Church Sign.

EventItemActionText:
Request approval of a new sign for the business located at 120 Church St NE., Docket No. PF-2031388-BAR, in the CS, Church Street East zoning district; filed by Mac Cassells, Project Contact.
Applicant present: Mac Cassells.
The applicant requested approval of an existing sign installed to resolve a zoning violation. Board members reviewed submitted materials and photographs and found the sign acceptable. No public comments were received.
Motion: Mr. O’Keefe moved to approve the request as submitted.
Second: Ms. Couchman 
Motion Carried (3-0)
EventItemTitle: 120 Church St NE - The Casey Sampson Team Sign

EventItemActionText:
Request approval of a new wall sign and tenant panel for the business located at 107 Center St N., Docket No. PF-2053869-BAR, in the AC, Avenue Center zoning district; filed by Chong Hyunh, Project Contact.
Applicant present: Chong Hyunh.
The applicant proposed a new wall sign and tenant panel. Board discussion focused on proportionality, spacing, and consistency with adjacent tenant signage. The Board recommended increasing white space and adjusting lettering size to be proportional and consistent with adjacent tenant panels. Staff will review revised renderings prior to final approval. No public comments were received.
Motion: Ms. Couchman moved to approve the request with conditions:
•	Wall sign lettering shall be consistent in height with adjacent signage and maintain appropriate spacing above and below. 
•	Tenant panel sign shall have increased white space and adjust lettering size to align with adjacent panels.

Second: Mr. O’Keefe
Motion Carried (3-0)
EventItemTitle: 107 Center St. N - Nailbox by Savior Signs

EventItemActionText:
Request approval of new signs and awnings at 121 Maple Ave W., Docket No. PF-1986462-BAR, in the AC, Avenue Center zoning district; filed by Kristina Robertson, Project Contact.
Applicant present: Lisa Richardson (representing applicant).
The applicant proposed new signage, awnings, and a window decal. Board discussion focused on color coordination, particularly the proposed black tenant panel background, with the condition of the existing pylon sign structure. The Board recommended painting the existing sign cabinet a consistent color, such as black or charcoal, if the applicant proceeds with a darker panel design after speaking with the landlord for permission. Additional discussion addressed lighting temperature (Kelvin rating) to be less than or equal to 3000 Kelvin and window tinting. However, window tinting was not part of the current application and will be reviewed separately.
Motion: Ms. Couchman moved to approve the request with the recommendation that the tenant panel structure be painted a consistent color (black or charcoal) if the proposed tenant panel design is implemented. 
Second: Mr. O’Keefe.
Motion Carried: (2-1)
EventItemTitle: 121 Maple Ave W - Gilded Pet Spa - Signs and Awning

EventItemActionText:
Request approval of EV charging stations for Navy Federal Credit Union, located at 1007 Electric Ave SE., Docket No. PF-1738347-BAR, in the CP, Corporate Park zoning district; filed by Tim Markle, Project Contact.

The applicant proposed installation of EV charging stations without bollards. Board members discussed safety considerations and the use of wheel stops and curbing as protective measures due to location of proposed EV charging tations. No public comments were received.
Motion: Mr. O’Keefe moved to approve the request as submitted.
Second: Ms. Couchman.
Motion Carried (3-0)
